name: Zeit AI
long_description:
Ask a question in plain English and ZeitMind connects SAP, your ERP, CRM, HR systems and 600+ other sources, prepares the messy data, and turns it into the live applications your teams actually make decisions with.

It is built for the finance, controlling, procurement, supply chain and sales teams at companies that run enterprise systems without an enterprise data team.
one_liner: The autonomous data engineer for the mid-market

question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer:
For years we worked side by side at Palantir, building with some of the largest industrial companies on the continent. Leopold led the established customer business across Germany, Austria and Switzerland. Marvin owned and deployed the first instances of what became the Artificial Intelligence Platform (AIP). Together we shipped projects that turned into more than €50M in new revenue.

In summer 2024 we left. We had seen what forward-deployed engineers do for large enterprises, and one thing kept showing up: the people who actually run a business, the heads of controlling, the buyers, the plant managers, are still moving data by hand. The signal sits in the ERP, in the CRM, and in a dozen tools that do not talk to each other. So decisions get made in spreadsheets and on gut feel. The gap between the two is where companies lose time, money and confidence.

With today’s frontier models that work can finally be done at software scale. So we are building the autonomous data engineer for the mid-market. ZeitMind connects SAP, your ERP, CRM, HR systems and 600+ other sources, prepares the messy data, and turns everyday business questions into live dashboards, reports and applications, all in natural language.

We joined Y Combinator in S24, put it in front of real controlling, procurement and supply chain teams, and went from zero to €1M ARR in twelve months with six people, customers live in weeks and no IT support needed. Today we are 12 engineers, builders and operators across Munich and London.

founders.title: Founder/CEO

Before that I studied CS at Oxford, published research on process mining and cryptography, and quit an MBA at Yale. I started my first business, weview, at 18, ran it for three years and sold it to DemoUp Cliplister.

founders.title: Founder/CTO
founders.founder_bio: Before Zeit AI, I spent five years at Palantir, where I owned and deployed the first instances of what became AIP, across chemicals, railway infrastructure, media, utilities, insurance and medical equipment. Grew up around Berlin, spent the last five years in London. Writing software for 18 years, professionally for ten, mostly full stack and data engineering. Deep learning research, more hackathons than I can count, and a weakness for InfoSec CTFs.

launches.title: 📈💡Zeit AI: Insights from your tabular data with just a few words
launches.tagline: Connect your ERP, CRM, CSVs to query them with natural language. 🗂️✅💬
launches.body:
### **🏆 TLDR**

[Zeit AI](https://www.zeit-ai.com/) is ChatGPT for enterprise tables. You can sync tables from your data bases, ERP systems, CRMs, CSVs and more. Atop of these tables, simple questions in natural language can be used to locate data, combine it, generate analyses, or even charts. All results are repeatable and explainable. They can be exported at the click of a button. [Watch our demo!](https://youtu.be/u3NcYh4zCz4)

# 🧑‍💻🌟 **The Team**

Together, [Marvin](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mcbornstein/) and [Leopold](https://www.linkedin.com/in/v-waldthausen/) have over 15 years of combined experience in data engineering and analytics. During our four years side-by-side at Palantir, we led high-impact projects, building an AI rule-engine and generating over €50 million in novel project revenue. We saw first-hand how corporates heavily relied on Excel files, leading to manual work to analyse and combine data. A solution like Zeit AI would have been a game-changer in accessing this data at scale.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83344&key=user_uploads/1927760/4024d05f-c883-4ea7-8053-a6e3eb0fdf7b)

# ⚠️ **Problem**

Non-technical users find it challenging to access and analyse enterprise data. Yet, making data-driven decisions is crucial in today’s fast-paced world.

1. Data is stored in files rather than structured databases.
2. Databases cannot be accessed by non-technical users.
3. Data often needs to be exported and manually combined in Excel.

# 💡 **Solution**

Zeit AI allows non-technical users to derive ad-hoc insights from tables using natural language. This is possible in just three steps.

1. Sync data files directly from your source systems (We support data bases, ERP, CRM and even CSV uploads).
2. A structured cloud database is instantly generated and ready to be explored.
3. Use natural language to seamlessly derive insights from the data.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83344&key=user_uploads/1927760/e6ce9c09-e77a-419e-8fae-adda888b1612)

# 🛠️ **How Zeit AI is Used Today**

**Procurement** 🛒 Gaining the upper hand during negotiations by having ad-hoc access to all historical procurement data.

**Consulting** 🗂️ Rapidly explore and analyse data rooms and client files using natural language to confidently deliver value to clients.

**Controlling** 📊 Access extracts from accounting systems and seamlessly combine them with files across departments for comprehensive financial control.

# ✅ **Ask**

[Book a slot](https://calendly.com/leopoldwaldthausen/deploy-zeit-ai) with us to explore using Zeit AI. Refer us to procurement managers and senior consultants. ([founders@zeit-ai.com](mailto:founders@zeit-ai.com))

Get on a [30-minute call](https://calendly.com/leopoldwaldthausen/zeit-ai-demo-booking) with us for a live demo or free office hours for anyone struggling to easily access tabular data at scale.
